A '''FastFlesh synthskin slap patch''' was a patch of [[Synthskin/Legends|synthskin]] that could be used to cover small injuries. It was produced by [[BioTech Industries/Legends|BioTech Industries]].<ref name="FDCR">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>
